project.model_title: ES26-081 Lon Eilian, Caernarfon - Quotation Q01

views.title: Foundation ICF
views.desc: Nudura ICF foundation walls, two courses below the ground-floor level: 6in XR35 external walls, 6in Standard party and stair-enclosure walls.

views.title: Ground-floor slab
views.desc: The ground-floor slab build-up inside the foundation walls, indicative pending the engineer's design.

views.title: Ground-floor ICF, partitions and porch steel
views.desc: Ground-floor walls, six courses to 2,743 mm, with the window and door openings, and the porch steel (UKB 356x171x45, TLS proposed) pocketed into the stair walls and the party wall. Ground-floor timber stud partitions (38x89 C16).

views.title: First floor and stairs
views.desc: 253 mm metal-web joists top-hung on cut-down ledgers fixed to the ICF with Strong-Tie connectors, 22 mm Egger Protect deck, and the timber quarter-turn stairs.

views.title: First-floor ICF and partitions
views.desc: First-floor walls to the eaves at 5,250 mm, the gables to the roof line and the party wall carried up to the rafters. First-floor timber stud partitions (38x89 C16).

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Fink trussed rafters at 600 centres with gable ladders, and the mono-pitch porch trusses hung on the porch steel.

views.title: Windows, doors and partition linings
views.desc: UPVC windows and doors set behind the 25 mm head and jamb overfly, the bathroom pattress ply and the partition noggins.

views.title: North elevation
views.desc: Complete structure seen from the north.

views.desc: Complete structure seen from the south.

views.title: East elevation
views.desc: Complete structure seen from the east.
